fields.System.Title: INV-401 — Quarantine stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a quality inspector, I want to put stock into quarantine, so that suspect goods
stop being sellable immediately, including stock already promised to orders.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given available stock, when I quarantine it, then its status changes and it is
  • excluded from availability.
  • - Given stock with existing reservations, when I quarantine it, then those
  • reservations are released in the same transaction and the affected orders are flagged for
  • re-allocation.
  • - Given a hold scoped to a batch, then it catches that batch in every location.
  • - Given stock already picked or packed but not shipped, then it is flagged for physical
  • interception.
  • - Given the change, then a movement with a quarantine reason code is written.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory, outbound |
| Tables | stock_balance, stock_movement, reservation |
| Risks | Hold not catching allocated stock ([doc 09 §8.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration (stock in every state) · rollback |
